ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Networks of Accounts, Entities, and Customers

Increasingly, fraud is being perpetrated by organized crime rings who leverage increasingly sophisticated fraud techniques and advanced technology methods to gain access to significant numbers of customer accounts. The subsequent movement of funds, both within and outside of the institution, can become quite complicated as the fraudsters attempt to hide their tracks and make potential recovery impossible. This scenario identifies networks of seemingly unrelated accounts, external entities, and customers. It detects relationships between unrelated accounts, between internal accounts and external entities, and between customers and accounts having no known relationship. These entities can be related by transactions or through shared common attributes such as Tax ID, e-mail, Phone Number, Address, and Password.
